provenance: PROVISIONAL. Visual judgements by Claude (Opus 5.5) from contact sheets of track crops and context frames, made 2026-10-23 for the cross-shot linking bake-off. Not owner labels; not checked by a person. Judged on the SAM 3 tracks in runs/nes-biking/objects.json (cache_nes-biking_v2.npz), by track id. One revision after seeing linker output: wooden ramp obj:288 vs obj:293 changed from different to unsure (see labels.wooden ramp).
rules: Per label, tracks are grouped into physical objects. 'different' = clearly another object (shape, colour or location); 'unsure' = cannot be told from the footage; covisible pairs are on screen together and are decided by the cannot-link rule, so linker scores use linkable pairs only.

bicycle.note: One rider and one bike (silver frame, dark wheels) throughout; the second bike lying in the grass in shot 22 has no track of its own. Some tracks drift onto the rider or background for a few samples (obj:131, obj:162, obj:257, obj:262) but follow the bike otherwise.

car.note: The white 1969 Mustang fastback: shot 33 (open door, rear louvres), 14 (sodium light), 20 and 7 (same parking garage, green-banded pillars), 9 (rear view on the fog road: same tail panel and spoiler), 35 (top-down: white roof, dark hood, quad headlights). Shot 35 is judged from shape and colour only (medium). Shot 2's car is a dark silhouette at night: unsure.

wooden ramp.note: Hand-built features of one compound, so several could recur across shots; only clearly different shapes are called different.
unsure_between: drop platform with railing by the grey building
drop platform with railing by the grey building
drop platform with railing by the grey building

white wooden ramp.note: The white flat deck on scaffolding (shots 11, 12; shot 32's deck edge judged the same, medium) vs the white curved walls (shots 18, 22, 27), the long plank (28) and the white-topped quarter (28). Whether the curved walls in 18, 22 and 27 are one wall is not decidable from these views.

street lamp.note: Shots 2 and 31 show the same lot (crane truck left, car right) and the same lamp. Shot 1's ten tracks are floodlights on a building across water. Shot 14's sodium lamp over the Mustang and shot 20's railway lamps are other places (medium).

concrete pillar.note: Shots 7 and 20 are the same garage with identical green-banded pillars: which pillar is which across the two shots cannot be told (unsure). obj:171 is a stop sign, obj:359 a concrete block in the forest.

utility pole.note: Shots 0, 9 and 35 are the same fog-valley road with a row of identical poles: which pole is which across shots cannot be told (unsure). Poles elsewhere (night waterfront, night lot, orange forest, dark aerial, compound aerial, railway) are other poles.

tree.note: Sample only. Trees in the fog valley (shot 35) vs conifers in the forest jump shots (23, 25, 30), and two deciduous trees (obj:89 big bush in shot 11, obj:259 tagged sapling in shot 27) vs conifer trunks. No same-tree pair could be confirmed.

wooden post.note: Sample only. Legs of the white flat deck's scaffold (shots 11, 12) vs legs of the dark tower (shot 17). Same-post pairs cannot be confirmed (identical legs).
